name: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite
short: Google's 1M-context Flash-Lite (GPQA 83.8%, SWE-bench 75%) for ultra-low-latency volume work; free tier on AI Studio/Zen.
modalities: Text, image, audio, PDF in; text out
freeTierNote: Free tier available on Google AI Studio and OpenCode Zen with standard rate limits
standout: The latency floor: Google’s lightest 1M-context tier for ultra-low-latency volume work, with a free lane on AI Studio/Zen.
tradeoff: The lite tuning gives up reasoning depth — GPQA and coding scores trail the full Flash line, so it lives on volume, not difficulty.
